name: self-correcting-draft-agent
description: Self-correcting LinkedIn post drafter. Draft-critique loop with rubric-based sensor, bounded iteration.

comments.express: Web server. Single dependency for production runtime.
comments.node_modules: Installed locally in this repo. Unlike DailyJobAggregatorAgent (which resolves via NODE_PATH to the shared OpenClaw workspace node_modules), this project installs its own deps because express is not in the shared workspace node_modules. Local install is the standard Node practice; the workspace junction is an optimisation for projects that share deps with the OpenClaw host.
comments.tests: Uses node:test (built-in) per the convention established by DailyJobAggregatorAgent. No test framework dependency. Test files: tests/test-*.js.
